description: A curated library of 100 reusable professional workflows for business, research, projects, software, AI, media, real estate, decisions, continuity, and controlled execution.

defaultPrompt: Recommend the best Argovance workflow for my goal and complete the task.
Keep this complex project aligned, checkpointed, and ready to continue in a new chat without inventing missing context.
Research this question using only claim-matched current evidence and label anything that cannot be verified.
interface.longDescription: Argovance Skill OS brings together 100 focused professional workflows for business, rigorous evidence-grounded research, projects, cross-chat continuity, controlled implementation packages, coding-agent execution, representation-first creative production, accessibility and interface-language review, behavioral AI evaluation, task and context control, evidence validation, independent review, software delivery, high-fidelity interfaces, realtime 3D, defect repair, code migration, performance, regression testing, continuity, media, writing, real estate, decision-making and operational execution. ChatGPT selects the smallest relevant workflow, production representation and expert configuration for the goal within explicit evidence, authority, quality, performance and safety boundaries. Personal, learning and everyday-life workflows are provided separately through Argovance Personal & Life. Agent orchestration does not automatically connect to or activate external services.
